scope: Display and client-side playback only; no simulator, reward, observation, source-elevation or server API changes.

sources.role: Optional worldwide street-map backdrop replacing the dense IGN raster chart and labels
sources.access: Direct browser viewport requests with normal browser identification, referrer and HTTP caching; no proxy, bulk collection, offline map packaging or training-image harvesting
sources.availability: Best effort community service for this interactive local prototype; use an appropriately licensed or self-hosted provider before scaling
sources.place_names: Provider-local geographic names; the UI is English, but the raster is not claimed to be English-localized

sources.role: Unchanged pinned MDT05-derived display terrain; existing acquisition and elevation provenance remains authoritative

map.orientation: Unrotated grid north; not a claim that grid north equals geographic true north
map.geometry: Terrain, domain, fire cells and censor guard stay in their native metric plane, with perpendicular grid edges. Street tiles are reprojected to that plane.
map.opening_extent_scope: Mainland Spain, Balearics and autonomous cities; Canaries intentionally excluded from this Malaga-focused camera fit to avoid a broad Africa/ocean frame, but reachable by panning
map.opening_sequence: Country fit; 1800 ms pause; 900 ms fit to public domain metadata. User map interaction cancels the transition. Reduced motion disables animated zoom.
map.zoom_out_limit: Country-fit scale recalculated for the current viewport size
map.geographic_limitation: Worldwide cartographic context does not extend the simulation or make this UTM projection a measurement tool beyond its area of use

trajectory.generation: Explicit Run to end resumes the current episode with its selected public baseline, committing and recording each real decision sequentially up to completion, truncation, a new invalid action, cancellation or the decision limit
trajectory.cancellation: An in-flight decision may complete and is recorded before generation stops
trajectory.replay: Start/Finish, slider and timed playback read recorded public frames only; no advance requests, future-state interpolation or private fire truth
trajectory.limits: A previously rejected action may be followed by a valid baseline decision. Unexpected episode/decision tokens and transport errors stop generation without hidden retries. Mixed-controller trajectories are not fair standalone policy benchmarks.
trajectory.storage: Existing single-session server frames and canonical trace export; no automatic training-data promotion or persistent save is added

validation.frontend_command: cd ui && npm test && npm run build
browser_checks: Street backdrop, blended source terrain, visible attribution and axis-aligned local domain
Tighter Spain overview, incident fit and native orthogonal grid geometry
Run to end completed and rewound to the initial public frame
Finish reached minute52; Start returned to minute0; keyboard slider movement selected minute2
Read-only replay progressed and paused; advance-request log count remained54 before and after replay
Live mutations and evaluator truth remained disabled in history
validation.limitations: Interactive visual smoke and regression checks, not new physics validation, historical reconstruction, model evaluation or a held-out benchmark. No GPU, model inference or live dispatch was used.
